entities.summary: Donald William Wuerl is an American Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Washington from 2006 to 2018. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Seattle and Bishop of Pittsburgh. Pope Benedict XVI made him a cardinal in 2010.
